entities.summary: Alla Oleksandrivna Horska was a Ukrainian artist and Soviet dissident who was associated with the Ukrainian underground and Sixtier movements during the 1960s. She was murdered in 1970; the official investigation reported at the time that she had been killed by her father-in-law, though Soviet archives have since revealed evidence suggesting the possible involvement of the KGB. Alla Horska was a painters & sculptors from Yalta (1929-09-18, Yalta–1970-11-28). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
